edits.source_proof: CPU mixed scoped-withdraw retains no sibling proposal; selected promise-withdraw+paid claim loses paid basis while paid-only control retains it; Brief B rules8-10. Forced note-assent-confirm is already covered by generic operation consent and is retained as a negative control.
edits.before: Withdrawing provisional permission or asking to hear the same readback again is a consent-state change, not automatically a refusal to pay. Remove consent, preserve independently valid proposed terms and offer no replacement date or persuasion attempt solely because permission was withdrawn. Bind the awaiting question to its operation and readback revision. A pause or intervening continuation/callback question suspends the payment-confirmation context and explicitly clears unconsumed payment authorization in the persistent store. A yes answering may we continue or the callback question cannot confirm the earlier payment readback, even with an affirmative producer label. On resumption, reissue the exact validated terms when appropriate and require a later unqualified payment confirmation; a stale authorization must not revive merely because the phase name returns to confirmation. A later fragment that completes an unfinished amount/date and also says "yes" cannot confirm a readback spoken before that fragment completed; require a new complete readback and a subsequent confirmation. Bind terminal truncation to its own clause, including a cut-off repeated number phrase; do not use unrelated earlier numbers, a full-balance synonym or a guessed suffix to declare that clause complete.
